crisisEvents.title: 🇨🇳 Chinese Civil War Intensifies
crisisEvents.description: Full-scale war erupts between Nationalist (KMT) and Communist (CCP) forces. The world's most populous nation hangs in the balance. Every major power must choose a side — or pay the price of inaction.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: After WWII, the Chinese Civil War resumes. Nationalists control cities but are riddled with corruption. Communists control the countryside and have peasant support. US backs KMT, USSR aids CCP. The outcome will reshape Asia for decades.

deploymentTrigger.description: Foreign military buildup in East Asia intensifies the civil war

China.outcome: All-out war devastates the economy. Cities change hands repeatedly. Foreign backers are drawn deeper — USA pressured to increase aid shipments, USSR forced to counter-supply CCP. Delays communist victory but destruction is catastrophic.

Mao uses ceasefire to consolidate rural bases. But the breathing room lets civilians evacuate cities and foreign observers praise the attempt. India and UK welcome the diplomacy. Communists still prepare their final offensive, but the world sees China tried peace first.

USA.outcome: Nationalist corruption wastes much of the aid, but the sheer scale forces Stalin to match it or look weak. Soviet Politburo hawks demand counter-escalation — draining USSR resources. Allied nations are reassured by American resolve. India gains leverage as a non-aligned mediator. The war grinds on longer, devastating China's economy further, but containment credibility is preserved.

Communists sweep to victory. Washington erupts — 'Who Lost China?' becomes a weapon. McCarthyism accelerates. Every American ally questions US reliability. Britain and France fear they'll be next to be abandoned. The USSR celebrates its greatest ideological victory since 1917. But you saved $2 billion and kept your troops home.

USSR.text: 🚩 Major Arms Shipments to Communist Forces
USSR.outcome: Soviet weapons flood Manchuria. Mao's armies gain decisive firepower advantage. The West watches in alarm — containment is failing. Britain and France worry about communist expansion reaching their colonies. But within the Communist world, Moscow's prestige soars. A grateful Mao signs the Sino-Soviet Treaty.

Moscow offers speeches but not guns. Mao wins anyway through sheer numbers and peasant support — but he remembers who actually helped. The seeds of the Sino-Soviet split are planted early. China's future communism will be more independent, more unpredictable, and less grateful to Moscow.

UK.outcome: Station troops in Hong Kong as civil war rages nearby. The colony becomes a refuge for Nationalist elites and their gold. Whoever wins China will remember British gunboats at their doorstep — but Hong Kong's trade position is secured for decades.

UK.text: 🏪 Maintain Commercial Ties with Both Sides
UK.outcome: Pragmatic British merchants trade with whoever controls the ports. Profits flow but both sides view Britain as unprincipled. Americans are annoyed at the fence-sitting.

India.outcome: Nehru positions India as the voice of reason between superpowers. Both sides publicly welcome mediation (privately ignoring it). India's prestige as leader of the non-aligned world soars. Everyone owes you a favor.

India has its own problems — partition looms. Stay out of China's civil war and focus scarce resources on building the new nation. A pragmatic choice, but a missed opportunity for diplomatic influence.

crisisEvents.title: 🇮🇳 India Partition Crisis
crisisEvents.description: India gains independence but partition sparks massive violence. 1-2 million dead, 15 million displaced.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Britain hastily partitions India along religious lines. Unprecedented communal violence erupts.

deploymentTrigger.description: Military tensions in South Asia accelerate the partition crisis

India.outcome: You save millions but economy suffers massive strain.
Army prevents worst violence in cities but can't be everywhere.

UK.text: 💷 Provide Financial Aid to Both Nations
UK.outcome: You try to make amends. Both nations appreciate gesture.
Maximum chaos. Your reputation in tatters.

crisisEvents.title: 🇦🇷 Perón's Economic Revolution
crisisEvents.description: Juan Perón nationalizes industries and creates massive welfare state. Third Way between capitalism and communism.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Perón nationalizes British railways, utilities, banks. Massive worker benefits program.

Argentina.outcome: Workers love you! Economy booms short-term but inflation rising.
More sustainable. British only moderately angry.

UK.outcome: Accept nationalization with payment. Railways were losing money anyway.

USA.outcome: Try to isolate Perón economically. Backfires - pushes Argentina toward neutrality.
Pragmatic acceptance. Argentina remains trading partner despite ideological differences.

crisisEvents.title: 🇻🇳 First Indochina War
crisisEvents.description: France attempts to reestablish colonial control. Ho Chi Minh's Viet Minh wage guerrilla war.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Eight-year war drains French treasury. Ends at Dien Bien Phu 1954.

deploymentTrigger.description: French military deployment to Southeast Asia triggers colonial war

France.outcome: Fight for 8 years. Massive costs. Defeated at Dien Bien Phu.
Accept decolonization. Save resources. Focus on Europe.

USA.outcome: Pay 80% of costs! They still lose. Sets you up to inherit war.
Position yourself as anti-colonial. Helps in Asia.

India.outcome: Nehru champions anti-colonialism. Leader of non-aligned.

USSR.outcome: Soviet weapons help Ho Chi Minh. Another communist victory in Asia.
Support decolonization publicly without major commitment. Focus resources on Europe.

crisisEvents.title: 🚨 Berlin Blockade Crisis
crisisEvents.description: USSR blocks all ground routes to West Berlin. Western powers must respond.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Stalin blocks rail and road access. City can only be supplied by air.

deploymentTrigger.description: Massive Soviet deployment to Eastern Europe triggers the Berlin Blockade

USA.outcome: Supply Berlin for 11 months. Stalin backs down. Western resolve proven.

UK.outcome: British RAF joins operation. Demonstrates Western unity.
Negotiate with Soviets while airlift operates. Moderate success.

France.outcome: French bases critical for supply routes. Strengthens Western ties.
Allow airlift but avoid military commitment. Domestic criticism.

USSR.outcome: If West succeeds with airlift, you lose face.

crisisEvents.title: 💰 Marshall Plan Announced
crisisEvents.description: USA offers $13 billion to rebuild Western Europe.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Marshall proposes massive aid. Designed to counter Soviet influence.

deploymentTrigger.description: American military presence in Western Europe prompts Marshall Plan to secure economic stability

USA.outcome: Western Europe recovers. Win Cold War economically.

USSR.outcome: Iron Curtain descends. East-West split solidifies.

crisisEvents.title: 🇰🇷 Korean War Erupts
crisisEvents.description: North Korea invades South. UN calls for defense. Major test of containment.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Stalin approved invasion. Truman sees this as test of containment.

deploymentTrigger.description: Soviet and Chinese military buildup in East Asia leads to Korean War

USA.outcome: Push to 38th parallel. If advance to China border, China intervenes!
Catastrophic for credibility. Every ally panics.

UK.outcome: Push to 38th parallel. If advance to China border, China intervenes!
Catastrophic for credibility. Every ally panics.

China.text: 🇨🇳 Enter War if USA Approaches Border
China.outcome: Human wave attacks. Push USA back. Massive casualties but prove China major power.

Argentina.outcome: Distant conflict. Focus on domestic issues.

USSR.text: 🚩 Provide Weapons and Advisors to North Korea
USSR.outcome: Soviet MiGs and tanks help North Korea. Risk of direct confrontation with USA.
Provide some aid while maintaining deniability. Let China take the lead.

France.outcome: Show solidarity with allies while preserving forces for Indochina.
Already fighting in Vietnam. Cannot commit to Korea. Allies understand... mostly.

crisisEvents.title: 🇦🇷 British Debt to Argentina
crisisEvents.description: Britain owes Argentina £150M for wartime food exports. Argentina demands payment or nationalization of British assets.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Argentina supplied food to Britain throughout WWII on credit. Now demands payment as Britain faces bankruptcy.

Argentina.outcome: Britain cannot pay. Seize British railway assets instead. Relations severely damaged.
Take control of British-owned railways. Fair deal - maintain relations.
Generous gesture. Britain grateful. Strengthens Argentine influence in Europe.

UK.outcome: Railways were losing money anyway. Fair settlement.

UK.text: 💵 Request US Loan to Pay Argentina
UK.outcome: More dependence on USA. Argentina gets paid but British prestige suffers.

USA.outcome: Perón refuses. 'Yankees go home!' Latin American solidarity against US.
Not your problem. Let them sort it out.

crisisEvents.title: 🌾 Global Commodity Price Surge
crisisEvents.description: Post-war food shortages drive grain and beef prices to record highs. Argentina dominates global food exports.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Europe is starving. Argentina and USA are the only major food exporters. Argentina uses IAPI to control prices.

Argentina.outcome: Huge profits! But Europe resents you. USA accuses Argentina of profiteering.
Good profits AND goodwill. Spain especially grateful.

Argentina.text: 🍞 Provide Food Aid to Devastated Nations
Argentina.outcome: Evita's charitable image extended to foreign policy. Huge popularity.

USA.outcome: Undercut Argentina. Europe grateful but American farmers unhappy.
Profits flow. But accused of not helping starving Europeans.

UK.outcome: Marshall Plan provides food. More dependent on USA.

France.outcome: Wine and culture for beef and grain. Mutual respect.

India.outcome: Developing nations should control their resources! Third World unity.

crisisEvents.title: 🌵 Argentine Drought Crisis
crisisEvents.description: Severe drought devastates Argentine grain production. The economic miracle falters.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: After years of abundance, nature strikes back. Grain exports plummet. Government reserves depleted.

Argentina.outcome: Cut spending. Unions furious. Peronist base cracks.
Compromise Third Position principles. IMF conditions hurt sovereignty.
Print money to fund programs. Workers love you. Inflation soars.

USA.outcome: Extend olive branch. Perón reluctantly accepts. Relations improve.
Perón refuses. 'We would rather starve!' Latin America rallies to Argentina.

UK.text: 🍞 Return the Favor - Send Food to Argentina
UK.outcome: Remember when Argentina fed us? Time to repay. Relations healed.

crisisEvents.title: ⚫ Death of Eva Perón
crisisEvents.description: Eva 'Evita' Perón dies of cancer at age 33. Argentina mourns. Political uncertainty follows.
crisisEvents.historicalContext: Evita was the heart of Peronism. Her foundation helped millions. Without her, can the movement survive?

Argentina.text: ⚰️ Grand State Funeral and National Mourning
Argentina.outcome: Millions mourn. Evita becomes eternal symbol. Movement unified in grief.
Her legacy lives on. Social programs maintained. Workers remember.
Use moment for reconciliation. Opposition cautiously optimistic.

USA.outcome: Diplomatic gesture. Maybe relations can improve now.

UK.outcome: Even former enemies respect grief. Relations warming.
